div.l: Trouthe ⁊and honorur . fredam ⁊and curtesie .
Full worthi was he . in his lordis werre .
And therto had he riden . no man ferre .
As well in cristendome . as in hethenes .
And euyr honoured . for his wothynes .
At Alisaundre he was . whan it was wonne .
Full often tyme . he had the bord bigonne .
A boue all nacions . in Pruce .
In lettow had he reisid . ⁊and in Ruce .
No cristen man . so ofte of his degre .
In Genade at the sege . eke had he be .
Of Algezir . ⁊and riden in Belmarie .
At leyes was he . ⁊and at Satalie
Whan thei were wonne . ⁊and in the gret see .
At mony a noble Arme . had he be .
At mortall bateiles . had he be fiftene .
And foughten for our fayth . at Tramyssene .
In lystes thries . ⁊and ay slayn his fo .
This ilk worthi knyght . had ben also .
Sumtyme . with the lorde of Palatye .
A geyn a nother hethen . in Turkye .
And euyrmore . he had a souerayn pris .
And though that he was worthi . he was wys .
And of his poort . as meke as is a mayde .
He neuyr / yet . no vilenye sayde .
In all his lif . vn to no maner wight .
He was a verraye . ꝑperfit gentill knyght .
But for to tell you . of his araye .
His hors were goode . but he was not gaye .
Of fustyan . he werid a Gipoıı̄un .
All bismotered . with his habergeoıı̄un .
For he was late come . from his vyage .
And went for to done . his pilgrymage .
With hym ther / was . his sone a yong squyer .
A louyer . a lustye bacheler .
With lockes crulle . as thei were leide in presse .
Of . 20ti. yere of age . was he as I gesse .
Of his stature . he was of euene lengthe .
And wondyrly delyuer / . ⁊and gret of strengthe .
And he had ben somtyme . in chyuachie .
In Flaundres . in Artoys . ⁊and in Pikardie .
And born hy well . as of so litell space .
In hope to stonden . in his lady grace .
Enbrawdid was he . as it were a mede .
All full of fresche floures . white ⁊and rede .
Syngyng he was . or flowtyng all the daye .
He was as fresch . as is the monthe of Maye .
